newsitem.title: USA: Gotham group holds 6.33 pct Bay Meadows stake.
newsitem.headline: Gotham group holds 6.33 pct Bay Meadows stake.

text.p: A group led by Gotham Partners L.P. said Monday it has acquired a 6.33 percent stake in Bay Meadows Operating Co/California Jockey Club.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it paid $7.66 million for the stake, totalling 364,862 common shares and holds the stake for investment.

The group said its stake include shares purchased between Auguast 12 and October 18 at prices ranging from $17.06 to $24.435 a share. The prices represent the price for a unit of one Bay Meadows share and one common share of California Jockey, which trades together with each Bay Meadow share, the group said.

The group said it believes that the October 8 offer of Starwood Capital Group L.C.C. of $22.00 a share to shareholders of Bay Meadows/California Jockey was "significantly superior" to an offer by Hudson Bay Partners.

The Hudson proposal involves a recapitalization of Bay Meadows/California Jockey in which Hudson would buy 15 million new operating partnership units at $20.00 a share and receive se3ven-year warrants to buy five million additional units at $25.69 a share.
The group said Starwood's offer was at a higher price and that it does not involve the issuance of warrants, thereby making the offer less dilutive to existing shareholders.

The group said it may contact Starwood or Hudson or both to discuss ways to improve their respective proposals. It said it also contact management, other potential investors and consider other alternatives to the existing Starwood and Hudson proposals.
